channel.title: West Coast Plant Project — BC Live Plant Orders & Pre-Orders
channel.description: Locally grown British Columbia native shrubs, wildflowers, vegetable starts, and herbs for Surrey, BC local pickup. British Columbia residents only; all live plant sales are final.

item.g:title: Nootka Rose (1-Gallon Pot) — Rosa nutkana
item.g:description: Vigorous native rose hedgerow shrub; wildlife rosehips. Wildlife & pollinators: Bumblebees & native solitary bees; high-vitamin-C edible rosehips; bright pink spring blooms; larval host for Erannis tiliaria & Malacosoma californica. Pickup window: Spring–Fall Pickup Locally grown for British Columbia residents only. Surrey, BC local pickup ($0). All live plant sales are final.

item.g:title: Red-Flowering Currant (1-Gallon Pot) — Ribes sanguineum
item.g:description: Early-spring pink-red clusters feeding Rufous Hummingbirds. Wildlife & pollinators: Premier early-spring nectar magnet for Rufous Hummingbirds, mason bees & bumblebees; showy pendulous pink-red flower clusters; host for Hyalophora euryalus (Ceanothus Silk Moth). Pickup window: Spring–Fall Pickup Locally grown for British Columbia residents only. Surrey, BC local pickup ($0). All live plant sales are final.

item.g:title: Saskatoon Serviceberry (1-Gallon Pot) — Amelanchier alnifolia
item.g:description: Edible summer berries; drought-hardy once established. Wildlife & pollinators: Sweet edible purple-black summer berries; cloud of white spring blossoms for native bees; larval host for Hyalophora euryalus & swallowtail butterflies. Pickup window: Spring–Fall Pickup Locally grown for British Columbia residents only. Surrey, BC local pickup ($0). All live plant sales are final.

item.g:title: Western Sword Fern (1-Gallon Pot) — Polystichum munitum
item.g:description: Evergreen woodland anchor for shade and root-competition slopes. Wildlife & pollinators: Lush year-round evergreen fronds; deep slope-stabilizing roots; overwintering shelter for beneficial ground beetles & native woodland moths (Phlogophora periculosa). Pickup window: Year-Round Frost-Free Locally grown for British Columbia residents only. Surrey, BC local pickup ($0). All live plant sales are final.

item.g:title: Salal (4-inch Pot) — Gaultheria shallon
item.g:description: Acidophilic evergreen groundcover for part to full shade. Wildlife & pollinators: Edible dark-blue Coast Salish berries; glossy evergreen foliage; pink-white urn flowers for bumblebees; larval host for Incisalia augustinus (Brown Elfin butterfly). Pickup window: Spring–Fall Pickup Locally grown for British Columbia residents only. Surrey, BC local pickup ($0). All live plant sales are final.

item.g:title: Great Camas (Potted Bulbs) (4-inch Pot) — Camassia leichtlinii
item.g:description: Deep blue-violet spikes thriving in vernally moist meadows. Wildlife & pollinators: Striking violet-blue star flower spikes; traditional Coast Salish edible bulb; spring nectar source for Bombus bumblebees & solitary mining bees. Pickup window: Spring Active Growth Locally grown for British Columbia residents only. Surrey, BC local pickup ($0). All live plant sales are final.

item.g:title: Pacific Bleeding Heart (4-inch Pot) — Dicentra formosa
item.g:description: Ferny shady groundcover beloved by hummingbirds & mason bees. Wildlife & pollinators: Delicate rose-pink heart blossoms from spring into summer; shade-loving hummingbird & bumblebee nectar favourite; larval host for Parnassius clodius (Clodius Parnassian butterfly). Pickup window: Spring–Summer Locally grown for British Columbia residents only. Surrey, BC local pickup ($0). All live plant sales are final.

item.g:title: Nodding Onion (4-inch Pot) — Allium cernuum
item.g:description: Edible native allium; bright summer pink umbels for bees. Wildlife & pollinators: Edible sweet-savory leaves, flowers & bulbs; nodding bright pink summer umbels that attract dozens of native bees, hoverflies & butterflies. Pickup window: Spring–Fall Locally grown for British Columbia residents only. Surrey, BC local pickup ($0). All live plant sales are final.

item.g:title: Common Yarrow (Coastal) (4-inch Pot) — Achillea millefolium
item.g:description: Tolerates dry sandy soils; premier insectary flat umbels. Wildlife & pollinators: Feathery aromatic foliage & flat white flower umbels; top insectary plant attracting ladybugs, lacewings, hoverflies, parasitoid wasps & native bees. Pickup window: Spring–Fall Locally grown for British Columbia residents only. Surrey, BC local pickup ($0). All live plant sales are final.

item.g:description: Glossy evergreen coastal mat with sweet red berries. Wildlife & pollinators: Fragrant, sweet edible wild red strawberries; glossy evergreen coastal groundcover; early white blossoms for native mason & sweat bees. item.g:description: Keystone Coast Salish savanna oak grown from local acorns; reserve ahead for seasonal pickup. Wildlife & pollinators: Keystone Coast Salish meadow tree supporting 100+ native butterfly, moth (Antheraea polyphemus), bee & songbird species; extreme summer drought resilience. Pickup window: Fall/Spring Pre-Order Locally grown for British Columbia residents only. Surrey, BC local pickup ($0). All live plant sales are final.

item.g:description: Warm-season sweet bell pepper transplants started early indoors; ready once night temps stay above 10°C. Wildlife & pollinators: Crisp, thick-walled sweet bell peppers ripening from glossy green to bright red; high in vitamin C; compact sturdy stems ideal for sunny beds & patio pots.
